definitions.gloss: running out of time; time-up; expiry of the time limit
definitions.explanation: The state of having used up the allotted time before finishing. Used of games, exams, negotiations, and meetings, often with the implication that the matter was left unresolved.

examples.japanese: {時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解|と}けなかった→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧。
examples.english: I ran out of time and couldn't solve the last problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまらない→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧まま{時間切|じかんぎ}れとなり、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}された。
examples.english: Time ran out before the discussion could be settled, and the decision was carried over to the next meeting.

notes:
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time) + {切|き}れ (running out), from ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧. The {切|き}れ element voices to ぎれ in the compound, as in ⟦{期限切|きげんぎ}れ→期限切れ：15893_kigengire⟧ (expired) and ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ (sold out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to run out of time
- {時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる: to end because time ran out
- {時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦{寸前|すんぜん}→寸前：12356_sunzen⟧: right on the edge of running out of time

USAGE:
Often used figuratively of negotiations or political decisions that fail simply because a deadline arrives, implying that one side may have stalled deliberately: {時間切|じかんぎ}れ⟦{狙|ねら}い→狙い：00312_nerai⟧ (playing for time).
